sql.query: select `r`.`id`,`r`.`roleCode`,`r`.`roleName`,`r`.`roleDescription`,`r`.`isOwnerRole` from `tbl_roles` as `r` where `r`.`isActive`=1 and (`r`.`tenantId`=? or (`r`.`tenantId` is null and `r`.`isProtected`=1)) and (`r`.`isAssignable`=1 or (`r`.`isOwnerRole`=1 and exists(select 1 from `tbl_user_tenant_roles` `ownerMap` inner join `tbl_roles` `ownerRole` on `ownerRole`.`id`=`ownerMap`.`roleId` and `ownerRole`.`isOwnerRole`=1 and `ownerRole`.`isActive`=1 where `ownerMap`.`userId`=? and `ownerMap`.`tenantId`=? and `ownerMap`.`isActive`=1))) and not exists(select 1 from `tbl_role_permissions` `targetRp` where `targetRp`.`roleId`=`r`.`id` and not exists(select 1 from `tbl_user_tenant_roles` `actorMap` inner join `tbl_role_permissions` `actorRp` on `actorRp`.`roleId`=`actorMap`.`roleId` and `actorRp`.`permissionId`=`targetRp`.`permissionId` where `actorMap`.`userId`=? and `actorMap`.`tenantId`=? and `actorMap`.`isActive`=1)) order by `r`.`isOwnerRole`,`r`.`roleName`
